items.title: 67425_Tiny Grimes oral history interview
items.q: playing with Tatum... We never had a rehearsal. And when he started playing, man, you just had to do the best you could to try to keep up.

ctx.x: No formal introduction, and all that stuff. "Is it all right we sit in and play, man" "yeah" That was that.

It was an honor but it was no pleasure He made it hard. It was hard. There was never a rehearsal, not show you somethin'. or [he would] say, "no that don't go like that that go like this" or "what's the name of that chord" Whatever I learned I learned it on the bandstand. Everything, sittin' on the bandstand playing. We never had a rehearsal. And when he started playing, man, you just had to do the best you could to try to keep up. It was somethin' else. It was a hell of an experience.
